code_hash_note: code_hash is the authorized value of record for the hashed set, cross-checked against research_state/campaign_authorization.json; canonical_source_digest is the portable identity of the tree (BRAIN-009).

confirmatory_window.note: No confirmatory-window candle has been read. The v3 confirmatory window starts after the v4 candidate freeze and needs at least 2160 closed hourly candles, so it cannot be evaluated in this session. Neither the v1 holdout nor the v2 confirmatory window is reused.

data_source.endpoint_policy: same-provider failover; selected endpoint recorded per asset

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest body with manifest_hash and snapshot_identity.data_manifest_hash removed, so that the manifest can carry the data-manifest hash without hashing itself into a cycle.

notes: v4 data manifest. Every accepted asset references an immutable canonical hourly CSV dataset under research/data/candles_v4. Synthetic records are never permitted. Nothing here is a research result: no grid, backtest, campaign or candidate selection has been run under v3.

prerequisite_status.note: configs/research_v4.json is immutable and still records P2 and P3 as OUTSTANDING; that statement describes the specification's own scope at freeze time and is not rewritten here. Flipping it requires a versioned amendment to the specification.

window_policy.note: The candle window ends at the last fully closed hour at the snapshot retrieval timestamp, so the dataset is bound to the same snapshot as the universe and re-running the validation reproduces byte-identical datasets.
